h: Toil in Torah Fulfills the Purpose of Human Creation

p: "'If you will walk in My statutes'
the statutes with which I engraved
the heavens and the earth, etc.";
and it lists there four expressions.
as Rashi explained from Toras Kohanim:
and we have said that this means
which comes through toil and exertion,
And this is "the statutes with which I engraved
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (רֵישׁ בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה א, א)
as they said (beginning of Bereishis Rabbah, 1:1):
"I was the instrument of the craft
that is, through the novel halachah
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה מט, ב)
to whom the novel insight is handed over
"'And great shall be the peace of your children'
who are occupied with the building of the world."
And this is "the statutes with which I engraved, etc.":
And this is what is written (Iyov 5:7):
whether he was created for toil of the mouth
or for toil of labor, etc."
that it certainly cannot enter one's mind
for the labor of this world.
And likewise, when it says afterward,
that there should be any thought
that man was created for such a purpose.
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (פֶּרֶק א דְּאָבוֹת)
follows what they said (first chapter of Avos, 1:2):
it is the work of the Mishkan,
"And the work was sufficient for them"
and through the heartfelt generosity of the donors
"Whoever is generous of heart shall bring it";
and as stated in the holy Zohar
And so with every act of tzedakah,
"By what shall the horn of Yisrael be raised?
He said to him: By 'When you take'"
that is, the donations for the Mishkan;
עַד הֵיכָן כֹּחָהּ שֶׁל צְדָקָה כּוּלֵּי
"How great is the power of tzedakah, etc.:
'his horn shall be exalted with honor'";
That is, the essence of tzedakah
only according to the kindness in it, etc."
And Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
who set up the pillar of gemilus chasadim,
for he fed all who came into the world;
is both for the poor and for the rich
the Name of HaKadosh Baruch Hu to be called
in the mouth of every passerby
and this is Torah studied in order to teach it,
for this is a Torah of kindness
Nevertheless, this is not the main thing,
And likewise there is the pillar of avodah,
וְזֶה הֶעֱמִיד יִצְחָק אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him, set this up,
For the korbanos of the avodah
and Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
wanted to set up this pillar
so that it should be for all Yisrael.
"Yitzchak went out to converse in the field";
and "conversing" means nothing other than prayer
For regarding Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
we do not find that he prayed for himself,
and he did not even pray for children,
as stated in the holy Zohar
who set up the pillar of avodah,
which is prayer in place of korbanos
(as they said in the Gemara there, Berachos 26b);
"What is the service that is in the heart?
You must say, this is prayer."
And this is what they said in the Gemara,
whether for the toil of speech"
"A prayer of the poor man when he is faint,
and pours out his speech before Hashem":
he knows that he is poor
and he pours out speech before Him.
like a servant before the king,
and from Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
And the main purpose of man
is that he was created for the toil of Torah.
that Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him, set up,
and from him no refuse at all came forth.
were called by the name Yisrael
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה רֵישׁ פָּרָשַׁת תּוֹלְדוֹת)
(as they said in Bereishis Rabbah at the beginning of Parshas Toldos).
For in truth man was created
also for the toil of labor,
(מִדְרַשׁ רַבָּה אֱמוֹר, וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה כה, ב)
"HaKadosh Baruch Hu will in the future
and likewise for the toil of speech,
כְּמוֹ רַבִּי חֲנִינָא בֶּן דּוֹסָא כָּאָמוּר
like Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa, as said above;
as they said in the Gemara
to be a laborer of the Torah."
And this is what it says:
"If you will walk in My statutes"
And it is placed next to the pasuk,
the Torah was given on Shabbos
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בַּזֹּהַר חֵלֶק א מז, ב)
as they said (in the Zohar I 47b),
"for through it the world was perfected";
and that is the toil of Torah she'b'al peh,
